import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path

agents_dir = Path(&#39;packages/ai/agents&#39;)
for f in sorted(agents_dir.glob(&#39;*.md&#39;)):
    text = f.read_text()
    # frontmatter
    m = re.match(r&#39;^---\n(.*?)\n---\n&#39;, text, re.S)
    fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    agent = fm.get(&#39;agent&#39;, {})
    mission = fm.get(&#39;mission&#39;, {})
    handoffs = fm.get(&#39;handoffs&#39;, {})
    output = fm.get(&#39;output&#39;, {})
    # extract system prompt unique body (before Universal operating rules)
    sp = re.search(r&#39;## System Prompt\n\n```text\n(.*?)\n```&#39;, text, re.S)
    prompt = sp.group(1) if sp else &#39;&#39;
    # strip universal rules
    if &#39;Universal operating rules:&#39; in prompt:
        unique = prompt.split(&#39;Universal operating rules:&#39;)[0].strip()
    else:
        unique = prompt.strip()
    # operating procedure
    op = re.search(r&#39;## Operating Procedure\n\n(.*?)(?=\n## )&#39;, text, re.S)
    proc = op.group(1).strip() if op else &#39;&#39;
    # output yaml schema fields
    out_block = re.search(r&#39;Primary schema: `([^`]+)`\n\n```yaml\n(.*?)```&#39;, text, re.S)
    schema_name = out_block.group(1) if out_block else output.get(&#39;primary_schema&#39;)
    schema_fields = out_block.group(2).strip() if out_block else &#39;&#39;
    
    print(&#39;=&#39;*70)
    print(f&#34;FILE: {f.name}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;ID: {agent.get(&#39;id&#39;)} | CLASS: {agent.get(&#39;class&#39;)} | ROLE: {agent.get(&#39;role&#39;)}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;TAGLINE: {agent.get(&#39;tagline&#39;)}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;MISSION: {mission.get(&#39;primary&#39;)}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;SUCCESS: {mission.get(&#39;success_conditions&#39;)}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;SCHEMA: {schema_name}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;SCHEMA_FIELDS: {list(yaml.safe_load(schema_fields).keys()) if schema_fields else []}&#34;)
    print(f&#34;RECV: {handoffs.get(&#39;receives_from&#39;)}&#34;)

import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path

agents_dir = Path('packages/ai/agents')
for f in sorted(agents_dir.glob('*.md')):
    text = f.read_text()
    # frontmatter
    m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.S)
    fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    agent = fm.get('agent', {})
    mission = fm.get('mission', {})
    handoffs = fm.get('handoffs', {})
    output = fm.get('output', {})
    # extract system prompt unique body (before Universal operating rules)
    sp = re.search(r'## System Prompt\n\n```text\n(.*?)\n```', text, re.S)
    prompt = sp.group(1) if sp else ''
    # strip universal rules
    if 'Universal operating rules:' in prompt:
        unique = prompt.split('Universal operating rules:')[0].strip()
    else:
        unique = prompt.strip()
    # operating procedure
    op = re.search(r'## Operating Procedure\n\n(.*?)(?=\n## )', text, re.S)
    proc = op.group(1).strip() if op else ''
    # output yaml schema fields
    out_block = re.search(r'Primary schema: `([^`]+)`\n\n```yaml\n(.*?)```', text, re.S)
    schema_name = out_block.group(1) if out_block else output.get('primary_schema')
    schema_fields = out_block.group(2).strip() if out_block else ''
    
    print('='*70)
    print(f"FILE: {f.name}")
    print(f"ID: {agent.get('id')} | CLASS: {agent.get('class')} | ROLE: {agent.get('role')}")
    print(f"TAGLINE: {agent.get('tagline')}")
    print(f"MISSION: {mission.get('primary')}")
    print(f"SUCCESS: {mission.get('success_conditions')}")
    print(f"SCHEMA: {schema_name}")
    print(f"SCHEMA_FIELDS: {list(yaml.safe_load(schema_fields).keys()) if schema_fields else []}")
    print(f"RECV: {handoffs.get('receives_from')}")
    print(f"SEND: {handoffs.get('sends_to')}")
    print(f"REVIEW: {handoffs.get('mandatory_review')}")
    print(f"TOOLS_ALLOW: {fm.get('tool_policy',{}).get('allowed')}")
    print(f"MAY_NOT: {fm.get('authority',{}).get('may_not')}")
    print('---UNIQUE PROMPT---')
    print(unique[:1200])
    print('---PROC---')
    print(proc)
    print()
PY

## 4) Key quotes — system intent

**README (`.cursor/agents/README.md`):**
> These are **project-scoped, readonly** Cursor development/research specialists. They do not add runtime product agents and do not alter the two live AI paths (disclosure mindmap + Prometheus chat).

> Route by need: Plan/gate → majestic; Acquire → fort; Extract → ruppelt; Credibility/prosaic → scully; … Cross-domain synthesis → keel.

> Core dialectics: MULDER ↔ SCULLY; VALLEE ↔ HYNEK; MACK ↔ SCULLY; GRUSCH ↔ SCULLY; KNAPP ↔ PILKINGTON; KEEL ↔ MAJESTIC.

**Vision brief:**
> **Honesty header… no multi-agent orchestrator exists in this codebase.** … The roles below are a **conceptual grammar** … They are NOT five processes, five routes, or five personas to be built.

> **Orchestration over replacement** — deepen the two live paths; do not spawn parallel agents per role.

> **The user is the investigator.** Agents propose, structure, challenge, synthesize — they do not decree. No role ever gets closure authority.

**MAJESTIC:**
> Every anomaly receives a plan.  
> You do not perform every investigation yourself. … Build the smallest sufficient investigation plan. **Route by function rather than celebrity.**

**SCULLY:**
> Belief is not a scoring criterion.  
> Distinguish evidence that an event occurred from evidence for a proposed origin. … Credentials, sworn testimony, institutional role, and sincerity are context—not proof.

---

## Audit verdict

The 18-agent roster is a **well-specified methodology library wrapped in celebrity skins**. Distinctive IP is concentrated in ~12 primitives (gates, ledger, credibility math, claim/knowledge typing, official-language taxonomy, contamination graph, cluster discipline, hypothesis/myth contracts, synthesis sections). Persona count should shrink to **5–7 roles** matching the vision brief; Cursor/Claude mirrors should stay generators over `packages/ai/`, not parallel canons. Product should continue consuming these as **prompt checklists / second-pass skills** on the two live AI paths—not as a new multi-agent runtime.
